home.introSuffix: from Harvard SEAS. We build AI-resilient interfaces that help people notice, evaluate, and recover from AI choices during open-ended work like reading, writing, ideating, and sensemaking.

researchThemes.title: Designing for hard-to-measure value
researchThemes.description: Recognizing activities whose value lies in the effort and experience itself, so AI assistance does not shortcut the meaning people would otherwise find.

researchThemes.title: AI-resilient interface design
researchThemes.description: Helping people notice AI choices and giving them the context to judge whether those choices are wrong, or simply not right for them.

researchThemes.title: Theory-connected systems
researchThemes.description: Building interfaces on theories of learning, attention, and emotion regulation, even when they defy common usability guidelines, and the infrastructure to do this across HCI.
